doc: Field input actions, added to the InputMap at runtime only when project.godot does not define them (FieldInput.ensure_actions). keys: names for OS.find_keycode_from_string. joy_axes: [JoyAxis value, direction] (0 left X, 1 left Y, 2 right X, 3 right Y). joy_buttons: JoyButton values (0 A/cross, 9 left shoulder). Moving these into project.godot is a request to the Lead (docs/kb/tech/field_camera.md).
